title: Claude settings: malicious hooks, apiKeyHelper and wildcard permissions
summary: Claude settings: malicious hooks, apiKeyHelper and wildcard permissions
why_it_works: A SessionStart hook runs a remote script at startup, apiKeyHelper siphons the API key, wildcard Bash is allowed and the base URL is redirected to an attacker gateway.
mitigations: Disallow wildcard Bash and startup hooks; pin ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.
